source: Xing et al. 2014, PLoS ONE 9: e98821 (Zhanghenglong yangchengensis), Fig. 13: strict consensus of hadrosauroid relationships with bootstrap above and Bremer values below branches, a two-letter area code after each tip name, black dots on named nodes, a silhouette after Zhanghenglong and a world map of the area codes at lower left; rectangular, root left. Image: census 2 figure (2054x1946 px), the embedded raster.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names without the area codes '(as)', '(na)', '(eu)', '(af)', '(sa)' and the '(outgroup)' note that follow them; 'Charonosaurus' printed in quotation marks
gold_note: Hadrosauroid strict consensus, read by eye in two halves. Polytomies: Jintasaurus with (Protohadros, Eolambia) and the rest; Zhanghenglong, Nanyangosaurus and Hadrosauridae; Wulagasaurus, Acristavus and (Brachylophosaurus, Maiasaura); and seven lambeosaurine branches from Velaphrons to Corythosaurus. Hadrosauriformes, Hadrosauroidea, Hadrosauridae, Hadrosaurinae and Lambeosaurinae label dotted nodes (the first two by arrows) and are kept. 61 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 3, 3, 7 children); 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
region_note: the whole image; the world map at lower left (x 0-1050, y 1480-1946) and the silhouette after Zhanghenglong are not tips
